text:
Sara (AE): Heads-up 10am exec with AuroraHealth tomorrow. CISO pulled an urgent ask: KMS BYO attestation + SLA on model availability. Need a one-paragraph status and owners.

Priya (SE): Quick list: BYO-KMS attestation, peering + IP allowlist, SAML smoke in prod, and a proposed uptime SLA for POC (99.5?).

Maya (CSM): Customer timeline: security questionnaire due Thu EOD, legal wants DPA redlines by Mon. POC kickoff in 2.5 weeks.

Tom (Security): For BYO-KMS we need their HSM vendor name, key rotation cadence, and whether keys are exportable. I'll send a short attestation template to their sec contact.

Raj (Infra): Peering looks straightforward; they requested mTLS which will need cert provisioning. 2 engineer-days to validate in staging.

Lina (Legal): On SLA: pushing back on unlimited credits. For pilot we can offer an availability target and service credits capped to monthly fees. Uploading DPA draft to drive.

sync-bot: reminder scheduled: exec-briefing -> 2025-06-12T10:00:00Z.

Priya (SE): Proposed immediate owners/etas: BYO-KMS attestation -> Tom (ETA: 48h), mTLS peering test -> Raj (ETA: 72h), SAML prod smoke -> Maya/Priya (ETA: 24h), SLA proposal -> Lina (ETA: EOD today).

Sara (AE): Perfect. I'll package a 1-paragraph status + 1-slide risk summary and send to Aurora execs. If anyone hits a blocker, drop it here and tag me.

Tom (Security): Sending attestation template now. Will also flag tokenization requirements if PHI is in scope.

Lina (Legal): DPA draft link: https://redwood.app/drive/aurora/dpa-draft-v1 1: review and react with :eyes: so I can finalize.

Maya (CSM): :eyes: I'll follow up with their sec contact for attestation after lunch.

Sara (AE): Thanks team. I'll post the slide before EOD and prep the exec notes.
